TABLE.NAME: qtype_algorithm_options
TABLE.COMMENT: Solution, starting template and tests of algorithm questions.

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key linking to the question table.

FIELD.NAME: solution
FIELD.COMMENT: The teacher's algorithm (base64 encoded JSON); the expected outputs come from it.

FIELD.NAME: template
FIELD.COMMENT: Algorithm students start from (base64 encoded JSON), empty for an empty diagram.

FIELD.NAME: tests
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON list of tests: inputs, hidden, weight, call (function tests), expected (computed from the solution). No tests: graded manually.

FIELD.NAME: afterinput
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 to compare only the output written after the last input.

FIELD.NAME: numbers
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 to compare only the numbers in the output.

FIELD.NAME: structures
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma separated structures the algorithm must use: if, for, while, dowhile, array, matrix.

FIELD.NAME: showtests
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 to let students run the tests that are not hidden during the attempt.

FIELD.NAME: grademethod
FIELD.COMMENT: 0: share of passed tests (by weight), 1: all tests must pass.

FIELD.NAME: ignorecase
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when capital and small letters are the same in the comparison.

FIELD.NAME: ignorespaces
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when extra spaces do not count in the comparison.

FIELD.NAME: tolerance
FIELD.COMMENT: Numbers in the output may differ by this much.

FIELD.NAME: hidetools
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 to hide the generated code and the file import and export from students in the attempt.

FIELD.NAME: parsons
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 for a Parsons problem: students arrange the blocks of the solution.

FIELD.NAME: distractors
FIELD.COMMENT: Extra wrong blocks of a Parsons problem.
